postToolUse.bash:
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; L=$(pnpm exec eslint --fix . 2>&1); LS=$?; pnpm exec prettier --write . >/dev/null 2>&1; T=$(pnpm exec tsc --noEmit 2>&1); TS=$?; if [ $LS -ne 0 ] || [ $TS -ne 0 ]; then jq -n --arg l "$L" --arg t "$T" '{additionalContext: ("eslint --fix:
" + $l + "

tsc --noEmit:
" + $t)}'; fi
postToolUse.powershell: Set-Location (git rev-parse --show-toplevel); $l = (pnpm exec eslint --fix . 2>&1 | Out-String); $ls = $LASTEXITCODE; pnpm exec prettier --write . | Out-Null; $t = (pnpm exec tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | Out-String); $ts = $LASTEXITCODE; if ($ls -ne 0 -or $ts -ne 0) { @{ additionalContext = "eslint --fix:`n$l`n`ntsc --noEmit:`n$t" } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress }
